name: wds_vtab-dsprites_label_orientation
description: A synthetic vision benchmark derived from the dSprites dataset that evaluates a model's ability to predict the orientation label of simple 2D sprites. It measures fine-grained visual feature recognition (rotation/orientation) on procedurally generated images with controlled variability. The task is useful for probing representation learning and robustness on low-level visual attributes.
reputation: A niche, synthetic benchmark commonly used in representation learning and probing studies (e.g., VTAB-style evaluations), but not widely used in large-scale community leaderboards.
